notes: Feature workflow: Login as member > Navigate to Cigarthèque > Switch to Membre mode (toggle at bottom of sidebar) > Click 'Ma Cigarthèque' tab. The accordion hierarchy shows Terroir (level 1) > Marque (level 2) > Gamme (level 3) > Cigares (level 4). Each cigar has 4 action buttons: favorite (heart), view (book), note (edit), delete (trash). 'Tout ouvrir' expands all levels, 'Tout fermer' collapses all.
